description: A savings account grows by continuous compound interest with a fixed annual rate and no withdrawals or fees.
Число пользователей региональной сети сначала растёт быстро, а затем стабилизируется около предельной ёмкости инфраструктуры.
A heated metal part cools in still air with heat loss proportional to the difference between its temperature and the room temperature.
В школе начинается вспышка гриппа: восприимчивые ученики заражаются при контакте с больными, а затем выздоравливают и получают иммунитет.
Wolves and deer live in a reserve; deer reproduce, wolves consume deer, and wolves die naturally.
A mobile app spreads through paid advertising and recommendations from existing users to potential users.
A bookstore replenishes inventory toward a target level while daily customer purchases reduce the number of books in stock.
A consulting firm hires trainees who gradually become experienced consultants, while experienced consultants eventually leave the company.
A brewery receives ingredient orders after a six-week shipping delay while continuous beer sales deplete ingredient inventory.
A deer population regenerates toward the habitat carrying capacity while a fixed fractional hunting quota removes animals each year.
An illness grants only temporary immunity; recovering people become susceptible again and seasonal contact rates produce recurring epidemic waves.

A Lorenz atmospheric convection model has three coupled variables and a chaotic butterfly attractor.
An electronic Van der Pol oscillator with nonlinear damping settles into a relaxation limit cycle.
A periodically driven Duffing oscillator moves irregularly between two potential wells instead of settling in either one.
